premise.title: Courtyard Embrace
grounding: A courtyard garden interpreted with elegant ease
Intimate and celebratory rather than themed or ceremonious
Climbing Mediterranean greenery, garden arches, and trellises
Aged tile rhythm and climbing foliage preserve an easy domestic welcome
premise.experience: Arriving should feel immediately welcomed and surrounded by cultivated life—intimate without becoming hushed or formal.
premise.foregrounds: The immersive courtyard garden as an intimate, easy welcome.
premise.distinctFrom: It offers the most enveloping and hospitable choice, prioritizing the feeling of being held within the garden over citrus-led vivacity or timeworn geometric order.
premise.organizingIdea: The garden becomes a hospitable enclosure, drawing guests inward through cultivated growth, architectural forms, and tactile age. The celebration feels already gathered around them rather than presented as a destination theme.
designConsequences: Greenery and architectural garden forms create a gentle sense of enclosure.
Tactile, time-softened surfaces make refinement feel lived in.
Botanical detail feels immersive rather than scenic or illustrative.
Formal cues remain relaxed and domestic rather than ceremonial.

premise.title: Ripe Radiance
grounding: Keep lemons recognizable and richly drawn
The atmosphere should feel intimate and celebratory
Warm, gracious, and convivial, with polished simplicity rather than precious baby-themed language
premise.experience: Guests should feel an immediate lift of warmth and sociability—polished but cheerful, vivid without becoming juvenile.
premise.foregrounds: Recognizable ripe lemons as the most convivial and celebratory expression of the garden.
premise.distinctFrom: It gives the event its most animated expression, favoring recognizable botanical character and convivial momentum over immersive enclosure or the quieter authority of age and pattern.
premise.organizingIdea: Ripeness becomes the pulse: fruit and leaves recur as concentrated moments of sunlit abundance, turning cultivated botanical detail into a lively invitation to gather.
designConsequences: Ripe fruit and leaves carry confident, carefully crafted detail.
Botanical moments arrive in a lively, selective cadence rather than as blanket decoration.
Refinement comes from composition and restraint while warmth remains unmistakable.
The character stays elegant and adult, never cartoonish.

premise.title: Weathered Rhythm
grounding: Softened, timeworn contrast with enough depth to feel established
Tactile surfaces inspired by limewashed plaster, aged paper, natural linen, and restrained glazed-tile richness
premise.experience: Arriving should feel grounded and unhurried, with the quiet pleasure of discovering detail that seems softened rather than staged.
premise.foregrounds: Time-softened tile geometry and tactile patina as the source of old-world character.
premise.distinctFrom: It offers the most structured and quietly enduring choice, drawing character from rhythm, patina, and depth rather than an enveloping garden welcome or citrus-forward energy.
premise.organizingIdea: Repetition supplies order, but age and growth loosen it. Weathered geometry becomes a calm underlying rhythm through which patina and cultivated greenery suggest an established, lived-in world.
designConsequences: Geometric rhythm gives the visual world calm, established order.
Patina softens structure so it feels relaxed rather than ceremonial.
Tactile surfaces reward close attention without becoming ornate.
Cultivated greenery gently interrupts the underlying order.
